field_principles.abstention_rows: Every unknown result stays in the denominator.
field_principles.arm_metric_rows: Separate arm metrics prevent pooled intervention claims.
field_principles.bootstrap_rows: Whole-row resampling keeps all four arms paired.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall time exposes interruption and implausible model work.
field_principles.execution_venue: The host venue prevents an unsupported remote execution claim.
field_principles.field_principles: A principle for each field makes missing evidence visible.
field_principles.frozen_fixture_ids: Ordered IDs prevent data-dependent row selection.
field_principles.frozen_schedule_hash: The upstream digest binds all 168 planned opportunities.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: The first failure names its upstream field and exact values.
field_principles.gpu_rows: GPU snapshots show availability, live use, and release after cleanup.
field_principles.harmful_flip_rows: Explicit flips prevent gains from hiding damaged correct controls.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A matching prefix states the outcome without model-judge claims.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The declaration states that one local Qwen generated every output.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: The class separates full generation from a blocked no-run.
field_principles.label_exposure_count: Zero means no sealed outcome entered model evidence.
field_principles.latency_rows: Per-arm latency retains the operational intervention cost.
field_principles.model_identity_rows: File and template hashes prove which model bytes were used.
field_principles.model_load_receipts: One lifecycle receipt proves that Qwen loaded only once.
field_principles.paired_comparison_rows: Matched deltas compare the same external-label rows.
field_principles.parse_rows: Typed parse receipts prevent silent repair of model text.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Exact comparisons show why inference was allowed or blocked.
field_principles.prompt_hash_rows: Template and executed prompt hashes make prompt changes visible.
field_principles.qwen_dual_side_pilot_complete_score: One reports matrix completion, not improvement.
field_principles.random_seed: A fixed seed makes generation and resampling repeatable.
field_principles.raw_output_rows: Unedited model output preserves failures and parse errors.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: A canonical digest detects later artifact mutation.
field_principles.rows: One row per fixture and arm prevents denominator drift.
field_principles.run_date: The fixed date binds the result to the requested execution window.
field_principles.schedule_identity_score: One means the executed call identities match Exp7153.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Byte hashes bind the result to the exact upstream evidence.
field_principles.source_structure_rows: Source-side checks expose each formal-structure requirement.
field_principles.sql_execution_rows: Read-only receipts preserve exact solution-side query output.
field_principles.status: A durable state prevents interrupted work from appearing complete.
field_principles.token_rows: Per-arm tokens expose unequal generation work.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class separates value, null, blocked, and disqualified runs.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False keeps SQL execution distinct from external correctness.
